contacts_reachable_check.name: contacts_reachable_check
contacts_reachable_check.value: "contacts"."normalized_email" is not null or "contacts"."normalized_phone" is not null

contract_signatures_subject_check.name: contract_signatures_subject_check
contract_signatures_subject_check.value: ("contract_signatures"."signer_role" = 'business' and "contract_signatures"."signer_user_id" is not null and "contract_signatures"."signer_contact_id" is null) or ("contract_signatures"."signer_role" = 'customer' and "contract_signatures"."signer_contact_id" is not null and "contract_signatures"."signer_user_id" is null)

expense_allocations_reversal_check.name: expense_allocations_reversal_check
expense_allocations_reversal_check.value: "expense_allocations"."status" = 'active' or ("expense_allocations"."reversed_at" is not null and "expense_allocations"."reversed_by" is not null and "expense_allocations"."reversal_reason" is not null)

expenses_supplier_location_check.name: expenses_supplier_location_check
expenses_supplier_location_check.value: "expenses"."supplier_location_id" is null or "expenses"."supplier_id" is not null

expenses_receipt_evidence_check.name: expenses_receipt_evidence_check
expenses_receipt_evidence_check.value: ("expenses"."receipt_status" <> 'attached' or "expenses"."receipt_document_id" is not null) and ("expenses"."receipt_status" <> 'waived' or ("expenses"."receipt_waiver_reason" is not null and "expenses"."receipt_waived_at" is not null and "expenses"."receipt_waived_by" is not null))

expenses_approval_check.name: expenses_approval_check
expenses_approval_check.value: "expenses"."status" not in ('approved', 'reconciled') or ("expenses"."approved_at" is not null and "expenses"."approved_by" is not null and "expenses"."receipt_status" in ('attached', 'waived', 'not_required'))

expenses_reversal_check.name: expenses_reversal_check
expenses_reversal_check.value: ("expenses"."expense_kind" = 'expense' and "expenses"."reverses_expense_id" is null) or ("expenses"."expense_kind" = 'reversal' and "expenses"."reverses_expense_id" is not null and "expenses"."receipt_status" = 'not_required')

job_charges_amounts_check.name: job_charges_amounts_check
job_charges_amounts_check.value: ("job_charges"."calculated_amount_cents" is null or "job_charges"."calculated_amount_cents" >= 0) and ("job_charges"."proposed_amount_cents" is null or "job_charges"."proposed_amount_cents" >= 0) and ("job_charges"."approved_amount_cents" is null or "job_charges"."approved_amount_cents" >= 0) and "job_charges"."invoiced_amount_cents" >= 0 and "job_charges"."credited_amount_cents" >= 0

job_charges_approval_check.name: job_charges_approval_check
job_charges_approval_check.value: "job_charges"."status" not in ('approved', 'partially_approved', 'ready_to_invoice', 'invoiced', 'partially_invoiced', 'credited', 'resolved') or ("job_charges"."approved_amount_cents" is not null and "job_charges"."approved_at" is not null and "job_charges"."approved_by" is not null)

job_charges_reversal_check.name: job_charges_reversal_check
job_charges_reversal_check.value: ("job_charges"."charge_kind" <> 'reversal' and "job_charges"."reverses_job_charge_id" is null) or ("job_charges"."charge_kind" = 'reversal' and "job_charges"."reverses_job_charge_id" is not null)

jobs_schedule_range_check.name: jobs_schedule_range_check
jobs_schedule_range_check.value: "jobs"."scheduled_start_at" is null or "jobs"."scheduled_end_at" is null or "jobs"."scheduled_end_at" > "jobs"."scheduled_start_at"

leads_service_details_check.name: leads_service_details_check
leads_service_details_check.value:
(
        "leads"."service_type" = 'material_delivery'
        and "leads"."material_description" is not null
        and "leads"."estimated_quantity" is not null
        and "leads"."estimated_quantity" > 0
        and "leads"."quantity_unit" in ('tons', 'cubic_yards', 'loads')
        and "leads"."rental_start_date" is null
        and "leads"."rental_end_date" is null
        and "leads"."debris_type" is null
      ) or (
        "leads"."service_type" = 'dump_trailer_rental'
        and "leads"."material_description" is null
        and "leads"."estimated_quantity" is null
        and "leads"."quantity_unit" is null
        and "leads"."rental_start_date" is not null
        and "leads"."rental_end_date" is not null
        and "leads"."rental_end_date" >= "leads"."rental_start_date"
        and "leads"."debris_type" is not null
      )

material_loads_loading_time_check.name: material_loads_loading_time_check
material_loads_loading_time_check.value: "material_loads"."loaded_at" is null or "material_loads"."loading_started_at" is null or "material_loads"."loaded_at" >= "material_loads"."loading_started_at"

material_loads_transit_time_check.name: material_loads_transit_time_check
material_loads_transit_time_check.value: "material_loads"."transit_started_at" is null or "material_loads"."loaded_at" is null or "material_loads"."transit_started_at" >= "material_loads"."loaded_at"

material_loads_unloading_time_check.name: material_loads_unloading_time_check
material_loads_unloading_time_check.value: "material_loads"."unloading_started_at" is null or "material_loads"."transit_started_at" is null or "material_loads"."unloading_started_at" >= "material_loads"."transit_started_at"

material_loads_delivery_time_check.name: material_loads_delivery_time_check
material_loads_delivery_time_check.value: "material_loads"."delivered_at" is null or "material_loads"."unloading_started_at" is null or "material_loads"."delivered_at" >= "material_loads"."unloading_started_at"

material_loads_reconcile_time_check.name: material_loads_reconcile_time_check
material_loads_reconcile_time_check.value: "material_loads"."reconciled_at" is null or "material_loads"."delivered_at" is null or "material_loads"."reconciled_at" >= "material_loads"."delivered_at"

material_quantity_variances_resolution_c.name: material_quantity_variances_resolution_check
material_quantity_variances_resolution_c.value: "material_quantity_variances"."status" = 'open' or ("material_quantity_variances"."resolution_type" is not null and "material_quantity_variances"."resolution_reason" is not null and "material_quantity_variances"."resolved_at" is not null and "material_quantity_variances"."resolved_by" is not null)

material_substitutions_decision_check.name: material_substitutions_decision_check
material_substitutions_decision_check.value: "material_substitutions"."status" not in ('approved', 'rejected') or ("material_substitutions"."decided_at" is not null and "material_substitutions"."decided_by" is not null)

material_substitutions_customer_approval.name: material_substitutions_customer_approval_check
material_substitutions_customer_approval.value: "material_substitutions"."status" <> 'approved' or not "material_substitutions"."customer_approval_required" or ("material_substitutions"."customer_authorized_at" is not null and "material_substitutions"."customer_authorization_reference" is not null)

operational_holds_owner_check.name: operational_holds_owner_check
operational_holds_owner_check.value: ("operational_holds"."project_id" is not null and "operational_holds"."job_id" is null) or ("operational_holds"."project_id" is null and "operational_holds"."job_id" is not null)

pricing_rule_tiers_amount_check.name: pricing_rule_tiers_amount_check
pricing_rule_tiers_amount_check.value: ("pricing_rule_tiers"."fixed_amount_cents" is not null and "pricing_rule_tiers"."fixed_amount_cents" >= 0) or ("pricing_rule_tiers"."rate_cents_per_unit" is not null and "pricing_rule_tiers"."rate_cents_per_unit" >= 0)

readiness_evaluations_owner_check.name: readiness_evaluations_owner_check
readiness_evaluations_owner_check.value: ("readiness_evaluations"."project_id" is not null and "readiness_evaluations"."job_id" is null) or ("readiness_evaluations"."project_id" is null and "readiness_evaluations"."job_id" is not null)
